tiers.label: L0 · Redirect objects behind the CDN

components.name: CloudFront HTTPS requests
components.assumption: 1M x $0.0100/10k (US) = $1.0. Gross list; always-free tier (10M req/mo) not netted.

components.name: CloudFront data transfer out
components.assumption: ASSUMPTION: ~0.5 KB per 301/302 response -> 0.5 GB x $0.085/GB (US, first-10TB tier) = $0.04. Gross; 1 TB/mo always-free not netted.

components.name: S3 website-endpoint GETs (CDN cache misses)
components.assumption: ASSUMPTION: upper bound with zero CloudFront cache hits: 1M x $0.004/10k GET = $0.40; website-endpoint requests assumed to bill at the standard GET rate. Each 301 is a zero-byte object with x-amz-website-redirect-location.

components.name: S3 redirect objects (storage)
components.assumption: ASSUMPTION: ~200 zero-byte objects; metadata-only storage rounds to $0. Created by IaC from a reviewed redirects file.

tiers.label: L1 · DB of record + cached service

components.name: CloudFront HTTPS requests
components.assumption: 10M x $0.0100/10k (US) = $10.0. Gross list; always-free tier (10M req/mo) not netted.

components.name: CloudFront data transfer out
components.assumption: ASSUMPTION: ~0.5 KB per 301/302 response -> 5.0 GB x $0.085/GB (US, first-10TB tier) = $0.43. Gross; 1 TB/mo always-free not netted.

components.name: Application Load Balancer
components.assumption: 1 x (730 h x $0.0225 + 730 h x 1 LCU x $0.008) = $22.27. ASSUMPTION: average 1 LCU (LCU dimensions not modelled).

components.name: ECS Fargate redirect/admin service
components.assumption: 1 region(s) x 2 tasks x 730 h x (0.25 vCPU x $0.04048 + 0.5 GB x $0.004445) = $18.02 (Linux/x86, on-demand). ASSUMPTION: task count/size.

components.name: DynamoDB rules table (on-demand)
components.assumption: ASSUMPTION: 20k rule writes/mo x 1 WRU x $0.625/1M = $0.01 + ~0.01 GB x $0.25 = ~$0.00; reads only on cache refresh (negligible). Total $0.02

components.name: CloudFront HTTPS requests

components.name: CloudFront data transfer out

components.name: CloudFront Functions invocations
components.assumption: 50M x $0.10/1M = $5.0 (one viewer-request invocation per redirect).

components.name: CloudFront KeyValueStore edge reads
components.assumption: 50M x $0.03/1M = $1.5 (ASSUMPTION: one kvs.get per request).

components.name: KeyValueStore API (UpdateKeys/PutKey)
components.assumption: ASSUMPTION: 1,000 API calls/mo (UpdateKeys batches up to 50 keys) x $1/1,000 = $1.0.

components.name: Application Load Balancer (admin plane only)
components.assumption: 1 x (730 h x $0.0225 + 730 h x 1 LCU x $0.008) = $22.27. ASSUMPTION: average 1 LCU (LCU dimensions not modelled).

components.name: ECS Fargate redirect/admin service (admin + KVS sync)

components.name: DynamoDB lookups (eventually consistent, <=4 KB)
components.assumption: ASSUMPTION: 60% served from KVS hot set, 30% of all requests are misses (bot scans). Origin sees 120M; Bloom (1% FP) passes 0.9M of 90M misses + 30M long-tail hits = 30.9M reads x 0.5 RRU = 15.45M RRU x $0.125/1M = $1.93.

components.assumption: Per-record 5 KB rounding: 600M records x 5 KB = 3,000 GB x $0.029/GB = $87.0. ASSUMPTION: rounding applies per log record; aggregate records upstream to cut this ~20x.
